risks.risk: Wrong fitment (Camry vs another Toyota model; pin-count mismatch; different transmission variant). Photo does not confirm pin count or exact model/part number.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear close-up photo of the gearbox identification plate/label (part number + transmission code) and the connector/pin count area, plus the exact Camry model/engine it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used gearbox with uncertain fitment (worst case: treat as not confirmed for Camry/22-pin).

risks.risk: Condition risk: may have internal wear despite seller saying 'tested and working' and 'no knock'.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the gearbox being tested (engaged in gear, no abnormal noise) or a mechanic test report with date.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: treat as needs overhaul/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Leakage/contamination risk (seals, torque converter area, fluid condition) not visible in this single photo.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the gearbox after cleaning showing any oil seepage points, and a photo of the fluid condition (if accessible) or a leak-check statement from the tester.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially requiring reseal/maintenance (worst case: assume seals may be bad).

risks.risk: Manual vs automatic (or different gear ratios) mismatch—photo alone doesn’t confirm type.
risks.proof: Ask for the transmission type confirmation and a photo of the selector/TC area or the tag that states AT/MT.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the least certain type (worst case: assume mismatch risk).
